items.label: Material
items.value: High Quality PU Leather. Lining fabric: Polyester. Size: 9.0"L x 4.3"W x 6.7"H. Weight: 1.1 pounds.

items.label: Elegant Design
items.value: This purse has a butterfly decoration which make it elegant and fashionable. Perfect for any occasion!

items.label: 2 removable straps
items.value: It has a fabric shoulder strap and a leather shoulder strap, which you can switch to any one according to your good mood

items.label: 3 Main pockets
items.value: It has 3 main pockets and 2 small pockets. It can hold your phone, lipstick, tissue, short wallet, or other small belongings. It is suitable for daily use.

items.label: Perfect Gift
items.value: It's a perfect gift for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, and Christmas.

items.label: Versatile Use
items.value: Made of eco-friendly PU leather, this small purse is easy to clean and highly durable. It can be used as Women Crossbody Bag, Women Shoulder Bag, Fashion Purse For Women And Girls.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash only. Avoid machine washing. Allow to air dry. Do not iron or bleach.
